content: Nohe Sheesha
Nohe nayta, Seema, Kaamanne Yaafeta yeletethay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa. Dhayo haathaafe guye, entaw adde nayti yeletidosona.
Yaafeta adde nayti, Gomera, Maagoge, Madaya, Yawaana, Tubaala, Mosahanne Tirasa.
Gomera adde nayti, Askanaaza, Irfatanne Togarma.
Yawaana adde nayti, Elisha, Tarsesa, Kiximanne Rooda.
Haysati Yuushoy abban teqetida biittan de7iya Yaafeta sheeshatas mayzata. Enti banta biittan biittan, banta doonan doonaninne banta kawotethan kawotethan shaaketidi de7iya dereta.
Kaama adde nayti, Kuusha, Gibxe, Liibenne Kanaane.
Kuusha adde nayti, Saaba, Hawila, Saabita, Ra7imanne Sabtaka. Ra7ime adde nayti; Saabanne Dedaana.
Kuushi Namiruude yelis; Namiruudey ha sa7an koyro wolqaama olancho gidis.
Godaa maaden wolqaama shankancho gidis. Asay, “Namiruudeda Goday nena wolqaama shankancho kesso” gidi anjey hessa gishosa.
Iya kawotethaas koyro katamati Sana7oora
biittan de7iya Babiloone, Ereka, Arkadanne Kaline.
I he biittafe Asoore bidi, Nanawe, Rehobootanne Kalaha keexis.
Qassi Nanawepenne Kalaha katamaape giddon Reseena keexis.
Mixiraymi, Luudeta, Anamimeta, Lahabeta, Naftuheta,
Patroosatanne Filisxeeme kochaa yelida Kasluheematanne Qaftooreta mayza.
Kanaaney ba bayra na7a Sidoonanne Heeta yelis.
Qassi Kanaane sheeshati Yaabuseta, Amooreta, Gergeseta,
Hiweta, Arketa, Siinata,
Arwaadeta, Xamaaratanne Hamaatata yelis. Hessafe guye, Kanaane sheeshati dumma dumma bessi laaletidosona.
Kanaane biitta zaway Sidoonape doomidi, Garaaranne Gaazara gakidi, Soodomenne Gamoora, Adaamanne Xaboyma bidi, Lasha7a gaki eqis.
Haysati Kaama sheeshata; entaw dumma dumma dooni, dumma dumma biittinne dumma dumma kawotethi de7ees.
Seemas nayti yeletidosona. I Yaafetas bayra ishanne Eboora nayta ubbaas mayza.
Seema adde nayti, Elama, Asoore, Arfakisaade, Luudenne Araame.
Araame adde nayti, Uxa, Hula, Geteranne Masheka.
Arfakisaadi Saala yelis. Saali Eboora yelis.
Ebooras nam7u adde nayti yeletidosona. Sa7an de7iya asay iya wode shaaketida gisho issuwa Pelega
gidi sunthis. Iya ishaa sunthay Yoqxaana.
Yoqxaana sheeshati haysata. Entika Almodaada, Salefa, Hasermoota, Yaraha,
Hadoraama, Uzaala, Diqila,
Obaala, Abmaala, Saaba,
Ofira, Hawilanne Yobaaba. Haysati ubbay Yoqxaana sheeshata.
Enti de7ida heeray Meesape bidi doloha baggara de7iya derey dariya Safaara biitta gakees.
Haysati ubbay Seema sheeshata; entaw dumma dumma dooni, dumma dumma biittinne dumma dumma kawotethi de7ees.
Haysati ubbay banta sheeshan sheeshaninne banta kawotethan kawotethan xaafetida Nohe nayta. Dhayo haathaafe guye kawotethati haysatape sa7a ubbaa laaletidosona.

footnotes.text: Pelega: Ibraawetho doonan ha suntha birshethay “Shaaketethi” guussu.
